Source: activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures
Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id AND activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno AND molecule_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1163101' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND target_dictionary.tid = activities.toid AND molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Sort: molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC
Limit: 1000
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
INNER JOIN assays AS a ON a.assay_id = a.assay_id
INNER JOIN target_dictionary AS td ON td.tid = a.toid
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary AS md ON md.molregno = a.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures AS cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND a.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1163101'
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
